Theory classes are used only when other issues do not meet their student needs and the teacher is available during the winter holiday.
All students must provide solutions when this theory is dedicated to the subject. There is no right to obtain credit when submitting the theory to compensate for it. However, you can choose between different periods with the same basic structure, and if you can't make your planned time in one of them, you can benefit from the theory course.
It is recommended that you come early in the week, so you have enough time in the evening or one day (if necessary).
